definition.simple: A tiny, invisible piece that makes up everything around us, like a single grain of sand making up a whole beach.
definition.academic: A minute portion of matter. In physical sciences, it is a small localized object to which can be ascribed several physical or chemical properties such as volume, density, or mass.

common_misconceptions: Particles can be seen with a regular magnifying glass.
Particles are completely solid and don't move.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student to imagine tearing a piece of paper in half infinitely. What do they eventually get?
